business_problem: inMorphis needed a repeatable way to upskill a globally distributed consultant workforce and productize AI, IT/HR, and sales-workflow expertise faster for customer delivery.
solution_summary: inMorphis needed a repeatable way to upskill a globally distributed consultant workforce and productize AI, IT/HR, and sales-workflow expertise faster for customer delivery. inMorphis implemented a ServiceNow-centered stack built around ServiceNow University, ServiceNow AI Platform, Now Assist, and AI Agents. Key components included ServiceNow University standardizes adoption with role-based training; ServiceNow AI Platform provides the common workflow and AI layer; Now Assist adds generative search, summarization, and drafting; AI Agents run AI-driven triage and response tasks. The stack also connected Microsoft 365 so the workflows could reuse existing records, documents, and collaboration channels instead of forcing teams back into manual handoffs. Teams learn through ServiceNow University curricula and labs, then apply those patterns in AI agents, portals, and workflow automations running on the ServiceNow platform.

solution_components.name: ServiceNow University
solution_components.role: Provides structured, role-based training and labs that standardize adoption of the platform and AI features.

solution_components.name: ServiceNow AI Platform
solution_components.role: Acts as the common workflow and AI platform that unifies service data, automation, and user experiences.

solution_components.name: Now Assist
solution_components.role: Adds generative-AI capabilities such as summarization, drafting, search, and guided responses inside workflows.

solution_components.name: AI Agents
solution_components.role: Execute AI-driven routing, triage, and response tasks inside support workflows.

data_flow: Teams learn through ServiceNow University curricula and labs, then apply those patterns in AI agents, portals, and workflow automations running on the ServiceNow platform. Feedback from pilots feeds back into updated training content and delivery playbooks.
business_outcome: inMorphis enabled 750+ professionals, amassed 1,500+ certifications, cut resource-ready time from months to weeks, and reported about 2.5x productivity uplift in a sales-workflow copilot pilot.
architecture_clues: Role-based curricula and hands-on labs are part of the operating model, not just one-time training.
